# Migaku

> > Migaku is an immersion-based language learning platform that integrates Netflix, YouTube, and native content with interactive subtitles and spaced-repetition flashcards.

Migaku offers fast, content-based language learning across 11 languages including Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, English, Vietnamese, and Cantonese. The platform combines streaming media integration, interactive subtitle technology, and scientifically-proven spaced repetition algorithms to accelerate vocabulary acquisition and comprehension.

## Key Topics

- Spaced repetition
- Immersive learning
- Netflix integration
- Interactive subtitles
- Flashcards
- Content-based learning
- Language immersion
- Vocabulary building
- Browser extension
- YouTube learning
- Flashcard algorithm
- Native content
- Language acquisition
